mapper.select: SELECT a.TYPE, a.MARKET, b.FUNCTION FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a INNER JOIN HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH b ON a.USERID = b.USERID WHERE a.USERID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_MARKET_AUTH (USERID, MARKET, TYPE, BU, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{userid}, #{market}, #{type}, #{bu}, #{registerDatetime}, #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, #{updateDatetime}, #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess})
